name: Workshop
description:
A U-shaped work cell with a timed curing stage.

Would flexible staffing or a shorter curing stage make a bigger difference?

Starting assumptions
• Two hours of evenly released jobs.
• Preparation and machining share two operators; finishing has one dedicated operator.
• Curing is a resource-free delay with unlimited space, not a finite rack or a chemical model.

Synthetic teaching models. Timings, demand and staffing are illustrative; layout does not add travel time.
